_doc: Routes in camera_match's street frame (u down-right, v up-right on screen; metres), read off the rectified plate. Each runs from off-frame or behind a holdout (scene.SILHOUETTES) to the same. kind aircar: uv = [start, end], hover = underside height (m), speed m/s, paint = actors.PAINTS key. kind walker (#610): uv = a polyline walked at speed m/s, look = actors.LOOKS key.

aircar_avenue._why: Down the lamp-lit avenue toward the camera, between the central flower bed (u 20) and the market tents (u 23.5), which hide it as it passes.

aircar_top._why: Along the banner street in front of the college, out from under the roof at the top edge, behind the clock tower, and off to the right. Mid-street (v 50.5), behind the lamp at the avenue crossing.

walker_don._why: Out from behind the south tent (crossing the avenue unseen, 6 s after the car), along the lit pavement between the central bed and the hall, then up the walkway between the central and left beds and in behind the clock tower.

walker_student._why: Out from behind the clock tower, down the walkway a metre to the don's left (they pass mid-way), then up the street behind the hall, whose roof (FrontHall) hides him.
